info.title: Battle Doll Angelic Layer
info.synopsis: Misaki Suzuhara è una ragazzina cresciuta passando sempre da un parente all'altro a causa dell'assenza dei genitori e che si trasferisce ora a Tokyo da una sua zia. Giunta nel pieno del caos della metropoli, le capita di assistere su di un maxi-schermo a uno scontro all'Angelic Layer, un gioco in cui si combattono delle piccole bambole comandate da remoto dal giocatore attraverso uno speciale device. Misaki rimane affascinata dall'Angelic Layer e se ne appassiona, decidendo di comprare anche lei il proprio Angel. Nel frattempo incontra uno strano individuo chiamato Icchan che le insegna le basi del gioco e con cui fa i primi passi per controllare la sua Angel, Hikaru. Insieme alla sua nuova compagna, Misaki entra nel circuito dell'Angelic Layer dove incontrerà molte avversarie sempre più forti.

episodes.title: L'attacco a Vega
episodes.synopsis: Dopo lo scontro tra Goldrake e le forze di Vega, Actarus fugge provato dalla distruzione causata. Alcor parte all'inseguimento e riesce a intrufolarsi dentro Goldrake. Actarus riesce a far atterrare Goldrake su un'isola deserta ma viene preso dai sensi di colpa.

episodes.title: Le tenebre inseguono la luce

episodes.title: Mazinga X

episodes.title: Un fiore da proteggere

episodes.title: L'ultimo inganno
episodes.synopsis: Teronna ama Actarus, ma deve mettere da parte i sentimenti: Washington è distrutta e Tokyo è nel mirino di Vega. Il Giappone valuta di consegnare Goldrake entro 24 ore per salvare la città.

episodes.synopsis: Rubina, sulla navemadre, contatta Actarus su Goldrake per discutere. Alcor lo rassicura: ce la farà da solo. Un mostro gigantesco minaccia Mazinga X, che resiste, ma la lotta sarà dura...

info.title: I'm a Noble on the Brink of Ruin, So I Might as Well Try Mastering Magic
info.synopsis: Cosa deve fare una persona quando la sua vita cambia completamente mentre si gode tranquillamente una bella bibita fresca appena finito il lavoro? E intendo dei veri e propri cambiamenti! Questo comune cittadino di mezza età ora si ritrova nel corpo di Liam Hamilton, il quinto figlio di un nobile la cui casata è sull'orlo del collasso. Fra un padre disperato per la situazione e dei fratelli totalmente apatici, Liam può finalmente provare a fare ciò che ha sempre desiderato: imparare la magia. Ma non sa che questa passione potrebbe sconvolgere la sua vita. Il ragazzo riuscirà a padroneggiare quest'antica arte? E basterà questo a salvarlo dall'ombra che incombe sulla sua famiglia?

info.synopsis: Un giorno Shen Yuan si reincarna in un fine cultore di arti taoiste, Shen Qingqiu. Shen Qingqiu è il maestro di Luo Binghe, protagonista da sempre destinato a essere tale e dunque figura assai overpowered. Secondo i racconti, Shen Qingqiu è però anche un cattivo destinato a essere ucciso dalle mani del suo stesso allievo! Ma allora, perchè pur essendosi reincarnato nel suo nemico giurato, il povero Shen QingQiu viene continuamente coinvolto nella vita di Luo BingHe? Perchè tocca sempre a lui sacrificarsi? E perchè gli tocca spesso ricoprire i ruoli precedentemente riservati alle figure femminili?! In questa storia, Shen QingQiu dimostrerà che anche i cattivi più infimi possono vivere con classe!

info.title: Jungle Emperor Leo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il film è ambientato in un momento imprecisato del XXI secolo, in cui la terra ha subito gravissime devastazioni ambientali e le Nazioni Unite hanno commissionato a un’impresa privata la costruzione di giungle artificiali in cui gli animali selvatici sono costretti a vivere. Leo (Kimba) è nato in questo ambiente artificiale, la sua vita è sempre stata facile e non sembra essere molto coraggioso: ma lui vuole diventarlo. La storia inizia quando Leo e Kenichi, un ragazzino che ha la capacità di comprendere il linguaggio degli animali, si incontrano. Speciale prodotto per la celebrazione del cinquantesimo anniversario di Fuji TV e dell’ottantesimo compleanno di Osamu Tezuka.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis:
Earth, sometime in the 21st century. Because of non-stop environmental destruction, the United Nations commissions a private company, "Eternal Earth", to create an artificial jungle, to be a nature preserve and to protect animals. All wild animals are forced to live in it.

The animals that live in this "neo-jungle" have an easy life. Leo, son of Panja, is born in this artificial world. Because of the unrealistic nature of the neo-jungle, Leo lives his life like he hasn't a care in the world. But Leo is ridiculed by the other animals; they call him a coward--he is not like his father, the great Jungle Emperor, but Leo vows that some day he will be.

Kenichi, son of the Eternal Earth company's CEO, has no doubt about the great success of the neo-jungle. The story starts when Leo and Kenichi meet. Kenichi has the special ability to understand what the animals are saying.

Source: www.kimbawlion.com/2009.htm

info.synopsis: Canada, seconda metà del XIX secolo. Gli anziani fratelli Matthew e Marilla Cuthbert decidono di adottare un maschio orfano che li aiuti con il lavoro nei campi. Recatosi alla stazione per prendere il nuovo membro della famiglia, tuttavia, Matthew si trova di fronte una chiacchierona ragazzina dai capelli rossi, Anne Shirley. A causa di un disguido, l'orfanotrofio ha infatti inviato una ragazza e non un ragazzo come richiesto; Matthew decide quindi di portare la piccola Anne alla propria casa e consultarsi con Marilla sul da farsi. Anne è un ragazzina dalla spiccata fantasia, che trasforma un semplice filare di ciliegi in fiore in una "candida via della gioia" e che, ancora ignara dell'errore avvenuto, non riesce a contenere la gioia di aver abbandonato l'austerità dell'orfanotrofio per andare a vivere a Green Gables, la famosa casa dei Cuthbert nota per i suoi verdi abbaini.

info.title: Zegapain
info.synopsis: Ambientata nella città di Maihama, la storia vede come protagonista Kyou Sogoru, un ragazzo delle superiori con la passione per il nuoto e i videogame. Un giorno, scopre improvvisamente di essere in grado di vedere cose che gli altri non possono; non molto tempo dopo, viene coinvolto, apparentementi senza motivo, nel mezzo di una battaglia tra robot giganti, dove finisce per pilotarne uno. Kyou inizierà a dubitare di questo mondo alternativo ma anche di sè stesso. La domanda che si pone è sempre la stessa: c'è qualcosa di vero in tutto ciò?

episodes.title: Entanglement
episodes.synopsis: Kyo Sogoru finds that he is the only one who can see Shizuno Misaki, a beautiful girl who invites him to play a game where he must save the world.

episodes.title: Cerebrum
episodes.synopsis: Kyo finds that strange things are happening in his world - like his friends disappearing from sight and Shizuno appearing only when he is alone. He agrees to continue helping her if she will appear in a film he and his friend, Ryoko Kaminagi, are filming.

episodes.title: Deutera Area
episodes.synopsis: As Kyo plays a game given to him by Student Council President Shima, he begins to question the reality he lives in.

episodes.title: Shanghai Server
episodes.synopsis: May-Yu, May-Yen, and Lu Sheng are determined to save the corrupted Shanghai Server with help from Kyo and Shizuno. When the server is destroyed, Kyo discovers the truth behind what is reality and what is a dream.

episodes.title: Deja Vu
episodes.synopsis: Kyo convinces himself that Maihama is real and so are all his friends. However, in his increasing confusion, he fails to appear for battle when the Oceanus needs him most. The Celebrants must defend themselves against the enemy who appears at last - Abyss.

episodes.title: Apparition
episodes.synopsis: Kyo tries to prove that what he feels and experiences within his world are real, but instead becomes temperamental as he realizes that even his friends may be nothing more than illusions. When he tries to leave Maihama to affirm the reality of his world, Shizuno finally explains the truth. The Oceanus is joined by Chris and Arque Avenir.

episodes.title: Wandering Soul
episodes.synopsis: Finally convinced that Maihama is an artificial illusion, including those cares most about, Kyo spends the day with Ryoko at the aquarium, who notices he has changed despite how he acts otherwise.

episodes.title: On The Other Side of the Water
episodes.synopsis: Memories that Kyo does not recall and off-hand comments from his comrades hint that Kyo's past is more complex than he realizes. Accompanied by May-Yu, he goes to see the real Maihama so he will experience the pain of reality and know why he must continue to protect his illusory world.

episodes.title: Wet Damage
episodes.synopsis: Chris reveals to Kyo that while the data of bodies can be reconstructed, memories that are lost can never be recovered - Arque has lost a great deal of hers from wet damage. Kyo and Ryoko get into a disagreement and Kyo questions the pain he feels from emotion.

episodes.title: Summer Comes Again
episodes.synopsis: Ryoko uses a video tape from Tōru Kanō to create a new film, not realizing that it is a sign she may "awaken" to the real world soon. She and Kyo make up during the Summer Festival.

episodes.title: Remaining Illusions
episodes.synopsis: Arque spends her last days making lasting memories with Chris, Kyo, Shizuno, and Ryoko. Sin and Abyss return and Ryoko begins to "awaken".

episodes.title: Those Who Awaken
episodes.synopsis: The crew of the Oceanus survey potential Celebrant candidates, which include Ryoko, Hayase, and Tomigai. Ryoko fully awakens and she spends the day with Kyo and asks to see the real world someday with him.

episodes.title: New Wizard
episodes.synopsis: Ryoko joins the crew of the Oceanus and goes around filming the real world as she wished. She becomes Kyo's new Wizard and proves to be an exceptionally skilled pilot, but tragedy strikes when the Altair is struck by Sin and Ryoko's apparition data is destroyed.

episodes.title: Destroyed Memories
episodes.synopsis: Kyo must overcome his grief over Ryoko's loss while Lu Sheng reveals what caused humanity to be stored within servers in the first place. Shizuno desperately searches through the raw combat data of the Altair and finds Ryoko's data compressed in the mecha's memory.

episodes.title: Reincarnation
episodes.synopsis: Things seem to be going right for Kyo - Ryoko will come back, he's finally made up with Kawaguchi, and his friends are happy. But the world itself is acting strange and Kyo finally discovers the server can only simulate a limited time period before resetting itself.

episodes.title: Revived Battlefield
episodes.synopsis: The Maihama server resets and the summer school term starts again; Ryoko returns to the server, but is hospitalized and comatose. Kyo discovers that Ryoko can only exist as herself within the Altair, which causes pain for them as well as those around them.

episodes.title: The Restored
episodes.synopsis: While Shima and Shizuno go on an excursion, Minato and the crew of the Oceanus must defend themselves against Sin, who has successfully infiltrated the ship in order to question the Celebrants' reasons for fighting the Gards-orm. Pleased upon receiving Ryoko's answer, Sin restores Ryoko's damaged data.

episodes.title: The Fabricated Wounds, the Withering Pain
episodes.synopsis: Ryoko's data is repaired thanks to Sin's data transplant, but her emotional data component is locked within the Altair so she is seemingly emotionless in the server. She and Kyo explore the real world, where he affirms that while he and Ryoko are only apparitions, they will some day be able to touch the real world.

episodes.title: Last Supper
episodes.synopsis: A suspicious Lu Sheng confronts Shizuno over dinner in the Maihama server concerning her recent actions and her identity as "Yehl". Kyo and Ryoko attempt to defend the Maihama server from Sin and Abyss, but are devastated when it is destroyed, unaware that Lu Sheng and Shizuno are still somehow alive along with everyone else.

episodes.title: Yel, Shizuno
episodes.synopsis: Shizuno and Shima reveal that the Maihama server is safe because it was moved on to the moon a while back by the previous Kyo with Shizuno and Shima. Shizuno and Kyo work together again and she reveals how they initially met and how he was the one who gave her the name "Shizuno Misaki".

episodes.title: Soldiers...
episodes.synopsis: Shima reveals Celebrum's plan for the final battle against the Gards-orm and for the resurrection of humanity. When Kuroshio believes the best option would be to become Gards-orm instead of gaining a true body and leaving the server, Shima attempts to reveal the real nature behind their enemies only to collapse from dry damage.

episodes.title: G-Phaetus
episodes.synopsis: Shizuno takes care of Shima, revealing that he is actually a clone of the real Shima, a Gards-orm who turned against his own kind to bring back humanity. Minato takes his place as the commander of the Oceanus and the Celebrants begin to execute their Final Plan: Project Resurrection. The Gards-orm begin expanding their destructive Deutera Areas on earth.

episodes.title: When the Moon Does not Sink
episodes.synopsis: The Altair and Garuda successfully infiltrate the Gards-orm base after fighting Abyss and Sin, only to enter the Gards-orm's quantum computer and be confronted by Naga and his views on the nature of life and humanity.

episodes.title: One Drop of Light
episodes.synopsis: Kyo, Ryoko, Lu Sheng, and May-Yu meet the real Shima, who waited for them and believes that they may not be able to execute Project Resurrection. The Altair and Garuda fight back against Sin and Abyss' Anti-Zega unit while the rest of the Oceanus' crew bid a final goodbye to Shima.

episodes.title: Is the Sky of Maihama Blue?
episodes.synopsis: Forced to abandon the Oceanus, its crew returns to the Maihama server and believes they have failed to recover the Maihama server and the resurrection system; however, a parting gift from Shima brings new hope. The battle between the Gards-orm and the Celebrants enters the Maihama server and Sin is finally defeated. Shizuno's true nature as "Yehl" is revealed while Kyo confesses his love to Ryoko before he and Shizuno leave to finish off the Gards-orm once and for all.

episodes.title: All Creation
episodes.synopsis: After destroying G-Phaetus, Kyo and Shizuno race to stop the expanding Deutera Areas on Earth by destroying their orbital base while carrying the Maihama server and the resurrection system's data compressed the Altair. Kyo finally defeats Abyss while Shizuno, with help from Minato and the other crew members, stabilizes the system and eliminates the Deutera Areas. Humanity's resurrection and restoration of the world finally begins.

info.title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
info.synopsis: La Chidori High è una scuola maschile prevalentemente frequentata da studenti di bassa estrazione sociale e con voti pessimi; la Kikyo Girls' High invece è una scuola femminile che ha come studentesse le figlie di famiglie ricche e prestigiose. Queste due scuole, che sono situate una di fianco all'altra, sono in continua disputa fra loro. Rintaro Tsumugi è uno studente del secondo anno della Chidori dall'aspetto da delinquente, ma dal carattere gentile, che un giorno, mentre sta aiutando nella pasticceria di famiglia, incontra Kaoruko Waguri. I due vanno subito d'accordo anche perché Kaoruko non sembra dare importanza all'aspetto del ragazzo, ma questa sensazione di pace viene rapidamente turbata quando Rintaro scopre che la ragazza frequenta la Kikyo. Questa rivelazione segna l'inizio di una faticosa storia fra i due, mentre lottano contro le limitazioni imposte dalle loro scuole e dall'ambiente circostante, nel tentativo di trovare la loro strada.

info.title: Doraemon il film: Nobita e gli eroi dello spazio (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nobita, Shizuka, Gian e Suneo impazziscono letteralmente per una nuova serie televisiva: "gli eroi dello spazio". Nobita, in particolare, sogna ad occhi aperti davanti al televisore di diventare un grande supereroe proprio come i suoi beniamini in tv. Decide così di girare un film di supereroi! peccato che Gian, Suneo e Shizuka, lo abbiano anticipato escludendolo dal progetto. Nobita, disperato, si rivolge a Doraemon che, grazie a un Chiusky Robot capace di creare degli straordinari scenari virtuali, riesce a convincere i ragazzi a includere lui e Nobita nel progetto. Insieme iniziano a filmare le prime scene, ma ben presto si ritrovano catapultati in una realtà che va ben oltre la loro immaginazione. Un abitante di un pianeta lontano, Aron, chiede loro aiuto per salvare il proprio popolo da un gruppo di malvagi pirati spaziali. I ragazzi, convinti che Aron faccia parte della sceneggiatura del film, accettano la missione senza esitare. Anche se ben presto si accorgeranno di non essere su un set cinematografico, dimostreranno ugualmente di essere degli eroi anche nella realtà.

info.title: Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
info.synopsis: Yūki si sveglia e si ritrova in una misteriosa villa, con indosso un'uniforme da cameriera e sdraiata su un lussuoso letto. Mentre indaga su quello che è successo arriva nella sala da pranzo e si ritrova davanti altre cinque ragazze che hanno lo stesso vestito. Presto questo gruppo scoprirà che l'unico modo per sopravvivere è quello di superare tutte le trappole all'interno dell'edificio: giochi mortali pieni di cerbottane, seghe circolari, stanze chiuse e armi letali. Una situazione senza speranza e terrificante per tutti i presenti... tranne per Yūki. Dopottutto lei, nonostante la giovane età, è una professionista di questi giochi mortali che si guadagna da vivere grazie ai premi in denaro che vince in queste violente competizioni. E anche questa volta non ha intenzione di farsi scappare questa opportunità...

episodes.title: Debut! Star Detective Precure!
episodes.synopsis: On her 14th birthday, Akechi Anna encounters the fairy Pochitan wearing a pendant in her room. Anna is then engulfed in the pendant's light and wakes up to find herself...

episodes.title: Introducing the Genius, Jett-senpai!
episodes.synopsis: Mikuru takes Anna to the CUREtto Detective Agency.

episodes.title: Everyone Come to the Curetto Detective Agency!
episodes.synopsis: As black petals flutter and anxiety spreads throughout town, Uta proposes holding a concert and inviting a “special guest.”

episodes.title: Exciting! Our First Client!
episodes.synopsis: The CUREtto Detective Agency gets its first client.

episodes.title: Star Detectives in Trouble?
episodes.synopsis: Anna goes to Makoto Mirai Academy, Mikuru’s school, to give Mikuru an umbrella, but then she meets a troubled woman named Mariko who is looking for her little sister Keiko. Meanwhile, Mikuru is asked by the school’s Chairwoman to solve a case involving a ghost in the high school.

episodes.title: Miraculous Pre-Kit Mirror Loupe!
episodes.synopsis: Mikuru leaves the care of exhausted Pochitan to Anna and Jett-senpai.

episodes.title: Yikes! The School Is a Maze?
episodes.synopsis: Anna transfers to Mikuru's class at Makoto Mirai Academy. While surprised at the size of the campus, she and Mikuru find themselves lost in a puzzle maze created by Goemon.

episodes.title: Pretty Smiles at Pretty Holic!
episodes.synopsis: Anna and Mikuru convince Jett-senpai to make merchandise from his Pre-Kit inventions and open a store.

episodes.title: Don`t Make Assumptions!
episodes.synopsis: A very popular actress, Shiruku Ieiri, comes to Makoto Mirai Academy to film a TV program which has her joining in on a play as a member of the drama club. But right before the performance a very special costume goes missing from the club office.

episodes.title: Solve the Mystery of the Painting!
episodes.synopsis: A client comes to the CUREtto Detective Agency, asking them to help solve a mystery.

episodes.title: Cure Arcana Shadow Appears!
episodes.synopsis: A calling card from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild is sent to the Hosho Art Museum. Anna and Mikuru arrive on the scene, there Luluka strikes a conversation with Anna while in the Starlight Princess display room.

episodes.title: The Secret of Cure Arcana Shadow!
episodes.synopsis: Anna and Mikuru set out on a fact-finding mission to learn more about Cure Arcana Shadow.

episodes.title: Star Detectives vs Thieves
episodes.synopsis: Anna and the gang chase after Nijee, who has stolen a toy robot. As they face off against the Hanninda, Luluka comes with a message: Maestro Usonoir is on the move.

episodes.title: Pochitan`s First Outing!
episodes.synopsis: Anna and Mikuru are on their way to school when Rei, the Student Council President...

episodes.title: The Secret of Luluka Moria
episodes.synopsis: In the letter that arrived from London, Anna and the others learn that Cure Arcana Shadow is a genius detective named Luluka Moria. They go to a lake in search of more clues, where they encounter Luluka herself.

episodes.title: Detective Ellie`s Case Book?
episodes.synopsis: Novelist Eliza comes to the CUREtto Detective Agency to ask to work as a detective to get ideas for her next novel. Not long after that, the girls get a request to search for a missing cat.

episodes.title: Memories with Mom
episodes.synopsis: Anna sees the mother of a client and thinks about her own mother.

episodes.title: Star Detectives Assemble
episodes.synopsis: While they help set up an exhibition at Hosho Art Museum, a glass slipper on display goes missing. Anna and Mikuru look for clues, certain that it was the work of the Phantom Thieves’ Guild.

episodes.title: Invitation to the Labyrinth Train?!
episodes.synopsis: Anna and Mikuru are on a school trip, but Goemon appears.

episodes.title: Legend from a Certain Island!
episodes.synopsis: A desperate letter arrives at the CUREtto Detective Agency: “The island could disappear!” Leading Anna and Mikuru to take a boat to the isolated island. To solve the case, they must unravel the secret behind an old island song.

episodes.title: Detective Ellie`s Case Book, Part 2?
episodes.synopsis: Eriza Kurusu appears before Anna and Mikuru and tell thems, “I want to join the CUREtto Detective Agency!”

episodes.title: Shiruku`s Resolve
episodes.synopsis: Shiruku Ieiri invites Anna and Mikuru to her show, and when they come to her dressing room, she shows them a calling card that was left by the Phantom Thieves’ Guild. As they search the theater before the performance, Anna spots Luluka.

episodes.title: Kurea, Sleuthing, and Ice Cream!
episodes.synopsis: Prompted by a prediction in the Tome of Mirages, Luluka goes to Patisserie ChuChu to steal a Makoto Jewel embedded in a photograph. When Kurea brings her some ice cream, Luluka hands her a calling card…

episodes.title: Case Closed with Rei!
episodes.synopsis: Together with Rei, Anna and Mikuru investigate some mysterious incidents happening at Makoto Mirai Academy. As they check the science room, music room, and art room, Rei notices a pattern.

episodes.title: Cure Eclair`s Identity
episodes.synopsis: The perfume Jett-senpai has been making is finally ready. Then, a new calling card arrives from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild. Cure Eclair’s identity will finally be revealed!

episodes.title: Cure Eclair Returns!
episodes.synopsis: Kurea’s memory has been restored by the Top of Lily fragrance. Shushutan also reveals herself in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Usonoir, who has misused the power of the Makoto Jewel, loses control and goes on a rampage.

episodes.title: I`m a Star Detective Now!
episodes.synopsis: With her memory restored, Kurea confesses to Anna and Mikuru that she was never a detective. As they reel from this news, the owner of a restaurant enters with a request for them to search for her missing cook.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Thief Decchi Agein!
episodes.synopsis: Paul, an exchange student from London, receives a calling card from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild and runs to the CUREtto Detective Agency for help. The calling card looks very flashy, and the listed time is down to the second, making it different from previous cards.

episodes.title: The Duo`s Past
episodes.synopsis: Decchi Agein and Goemon replay Kurea’s world of memories. There, Anna and the gang witness Kurea and Luluka’s first meeting at the London CUREtto Detective Agency three years earlier.

episodes.title: Eclipse Shadow
episodes.synopsis: During the summer holidays, Anna and the others go to Makoto Mirai Academy to help student council president Rei care for the flower beds. While working, they realize that the zinnias that were blooming just minutes earlier have all been cut.

episodes.title: Star Detective Cure Arcana
episodes.synopsis: Cure Answer and the others have their transformations dissolved by the sheer power of Eclipse Shadow. As Cure Eclair’s secrets and Luluka’s true intentions are revealed, Anna and Mikuru transform into Precures again and extend their hands to Kurea.

episodes.title: I`m Back, Curetto Detective Agency
episodes.synopsis: With nowhere to go, Luluka spends her days at Pâtisserie ChuChu. While she’s there, a customer’s lost item containing a Makoto Jewel is stolen. Anna and the others deduce that the culprit must be among three customers on the terrace and prepare to question them, but Luluka intervenes.

episodes.title: The Path to Star Detective Starts with a Single Step
episodes.synopsis: Just as Luluka is settling into the CUREtto Detective Agency, Goemon barges in. Unable to accept her departure from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild, he generates a trick maze to test her skills. Countless doors appear, all leading to other worlds, and who appears from behind those doors...?

episodes.title: Luluka and the Gold-Star Full Moon
episodes.synopsis: Anna and the others recover a wooden box that was stolen by the Phantom Thieves’ Guild and take it to the police for help with finding the owner. Shiruku Ieiri is there as Police Chief for a day, and helps put out a call for the owner, but three people arrive, all claiming to own the item.

episodes.title: Love Detectives
episodes.synopsis: Kurea and Luluka begin attending high school at Minato Mirai Academy. Their new classmates try striking up a conversation with Luluka but she’s unable to respond well. Just then, she notices a love letter on the floor of the classroom.

episodes.title: The Gold Medal of Trials
episodes.synopsis: Anna and the others enter a bookstore in the shopping arcade in pursuit of a Makoto Jewel. As they work to deduce the whereabouts of the shopkeeper’s stolen gold medal, a conversation with a high school girl named Haruna Makifusa, who happened to stop by, provides them with a valuable hint.

episodes.title: Usonoir and Nijee`s Tea Time
episodes.synopsis: Usonoir and Nijee steal Makopyon, a mascot suit for the shopping arcade with a Makoto Jewel inside, and run away from Anna and the others. Then, they disguise themselves as customers and duck into Patisserie ChuChu to wait until the heat is off.

episodes.title: Kurea`s Answer
episodes.synopsis: Anna, Mikuru, and Luluka head out for the day, leaving Kurea at the quiet CUREtto Detective Agency to ruminate about why she has the power of the Forgotten Race. Then, a client comes in with a calling card she got from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild.

episodes.title: An Ojamajo Halloween
episodes.synopsis: A suggestion from Anna leads the shopping arcade to hold a Halloween event. Anna and the others get dressed up in costumes and go to help out. There they meet a girl named Hinano who has been separated from her mom.

info.title: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
info.synopsis: Kanata Kitami è un ragazzo timido che da anni ama la sua amica d'infanzia, Marika Chitose. Una notte desidera di poter capire i sentimenti degli altri e, incredibilmente, il giorno dopo inizia a vedere dei “love meter” sopra le persone: indicatori che mostrano quanto affetto provino per lui. Quando controlla quello di Marika, però, rimane scioccato: il suo indicatore non è solo basso… è sceso sotto lo zero, come se fosse precipitato oltre il limite. Un risultato assurdo, soprattutto perché Marika lo tratta sempre con gentilezza. Determinato a capire quel mistero, Kanata si ritrova coinvolto in equivoci, momenti romantici e piccole rivelazioni, mentre scopre che il cuore di una persona è molto più imprevedibile di qualsiasi misuratore.

episodes.title: Now I Can See the Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: Lacking the courage to confess to my childhood friend, Marika, I make a strong wish upon a shooting star. And now, I can see the lovemeters over the girls in my class. Confused by this surreal sight, I look over at Marika, only to find that her meter's had a total meltdown to rotten depths...?! Marika, why is it that you were always so kind to me, then...? What is the real meaning behind the lovemeter...?

episodes.title: The Highs and Lows of the Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: I've got to do something about my crush, Marika's completely broken lovemeter. First, I figured I should get along with Toyotomi, whose lovemeter is low, but she treats me so harshly, I get discouraged quickly. However, after school, when I help a crying girl at the usual park and take her home, it was Toyotomi's house?! Apparently, the girl was Toyotomi's younger sister! As soon as she invites me to have dinner together as thanks, her lovemeter goes up...

episodes.title: The Awakening of the Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: Racking my brains over what to do with Marika's lovemeter, I bump into my classmate, Mikasa, who was walking her dog at the usual park. Being fellow dog-lovers and sparking conversation over them, her lovemeter is high. I try to act uncool in order to lower Mikasa's lovemeter for the sake of my true love, Marika, but on the contrary...?! Unbeknownst to me, Marika, passing by, witnesses the whole thing...

episodes.title: The Unstoppable Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: On this day, Marika's lovemeter was completely possessed by a raged and jealous demoness, while she herself had a blank expression. I keep doing my best to approach Marika, not wanting to be disliked. No matter what I did though, she wouldn't smile. But I won't give up. Then, taking a chance, I successfully ask Marika out on a date during lunchtime! But Toyotomi appears before us, and the lovemeter undergoes a sudden change?! In response to that, Marika's lovemeter...

episodes.title: The Ever-Soaring Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: I was up on cloud nine after finally landing a date with my beloved Marika at the aquarium. She loves seals, and seeing her carefree smile made it all worth it. But even though I wanted to take things further, I just couldn't muster the courage... Then, during the dolphin show, we end up getting soaked to the bone! Having prepared a change of clothes just in case, I head to our respective changing rooms... But then, the unthinkable happened?!

episodes.title: The Invisible Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: Niino, a tomboyish returnee, transfers to our school, and the boys are buzzing with excitement. For some reason, I couldn't see Niino's lovemeter, but she felt strangely familiar. Why is it that Marika's smiling at me, while my heart's racing over Niino's beauty...? After school, Niino and I end up walking home together and we arrive at the usual park. This place holds so many childhood memories with Marika... Wait, could you be that girl from my memories of playing in the park...?!

episodes.title: The Original-Exceeding Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: A demon was dwelling in Marika's lovemeter. During lunch break, while eating with a depressed Marika, Toyotomi comes over. Then, with a girlish expression unimaginable from her usually harsh demeanor, she asks if it's okay to eat lunch together...!? Marika's face darkens, and the demon dwelling in her lovemeter begins to rage! Then Mikasa and Niino join the fray, causing the lovemeters to undergo a climactic change!!!

episodes.title: The Completely Kaput Lovemeter
episodes.synopsis: Marika, Toyotomi, Mikasa, and Niino's lovemeters go on a rampage! I feel like I'm being suffocated by all these lovemeters... Just as I thought hard for everyone not to fight over me, I get baptized by the lovemeter only I can see, and I'm on the verge of death. Somehow I manage to confess to Marika, saying she's the one I truly love, but... With that, Marika's lovemeter goes even more completely haywire???!!

info.title: Mimì e le ragazze della pallavolo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il club di pallavolo del liceo internazionale Tachibana è stato sciolto a causa della tragica morte di un'allieva; si racconta addirittura che il suo fantasma si aggiri ancora nella sede del club. Mimì Miceri, anch'essa allieva della scuola, si impegna con tutte le sue forze per riaprirlo, lottando contro l'indifferenza se non l'avversione degli altri studenti. Affrontando molti problemi che sembrano più volte minare il suo progetto, riesce finalmente a formare una squadra di sei ragazze per poter partecipare ai campionati giovanili.

I vampiri decidono di pagarsi l’integrazione razziale: in cambio del saldo totale del debito pubblico del Giappone, lo Stato dovrà accogliere qualsiasi vampiro nel mondo che chieda asilo.

episodes.title: The Lost Boys

episodes.title: Walpurgis Night

episodes.title: Dance in the Vampire Bund
episodes.synopsis: Two beastly warriors shed blood in defense of identical princesses, and Mina learns the shocking secret behind the legacy of the true bloods! Mina then made a pledge to Akria to stay with him forever like Akria did as a young boy.
